items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: the very first jazz I heard was Turk Murphy’s band on the radio

ctx.x: So what kind of music did you listen to when you got into your teens? Did you get into jazz recordings?

No, not at all until college. The first jazz, apart from this band that came by on the truck (I think they were playing “Saints” or something), the very first jazz I heard was Turk Murphy’s band on the radio, from the University of the Pacific radio station. And shortly after that the family emigrated to Sydney and I started looking around for jazz. I was starting to collect ‘78s and I got a big job in a music store which was good. The whole idea was for me to go — we were going to settle in a city. We could…
What was the music scene like in Australia? You said this was early 70s?
